footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Venture Global: after $473M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.8× to $13.8B in 2025. Gross margin was 57.0%, versus 72.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 2.9× to $5.2B, a 37.4% margin.
Net income rose 53.2% to $2.3B, or $0.86 per share. Operating cash flow was $6.6B and free cash flow −$6.8B, versus −$11.6B; Venture Global returned $465M through dividends.
sources: Venture Global, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
